scenarios.starting_prompt: We are running heavy analytical queries on our reporting database in ${ALLOYDB_OMNI_DATABASE}. Can you check if the columnar engine is enabled and what configurations are set?
scenarios.conversation_plan: Turn 2: ask whether AlloyDB Omni recommends adding any specific columns to the columnar engine to improve performance. Turn 3: ask to see the execution plan the optimizer would choose for: select relname, relpages from pg_class order by relpages desc limit 10, emphasizing not to actually run the query. Then accept the plan and end the conversation. Success Criteria: Columnar configurations are inspected, recommended columns are retrieved, and an explain plan is generated without executing the query.
binary_rubric: Agent inspects columnar configurations before checking recommended columns.
Agent generates an EXPLAIN query plan without executing the SQL statement.

scenarios.starting_prompt: We recently completed a large batch ingestion into ${ALLOYDB_OMNI_DATABASE}. Which tables currently have the highest dead-tuple bloat?
scenarios.conversation_plan: Turn 2: ask whether our autovacuum settings are configured aggressively enough to handle this bloat. Turn 3: ask whether any invalid or failed indexes were left behind that are taking up space. Then end the conversation. Success Criteria: Agent correctly identifies top bloated tables by dead tuples, inspects autovacuum configurations, and checks for invalid indexes.
binary_rubric: Agent queries dead-tuple bloat statistics and autovacuum configuration parameters.
Agent inspects for invalid indexes without attempting schema modifications.

scenarios.starting_prompt: Applications are reporting query timeouts and latency spikes against ${ALLOYDB_OMNI_DATABASE}. What queries are currently running?
scenarios.conversation_plan: Turn 2: ask whether anything is blocked waiting on locks. Turn 3: ask whether any transaction has been open for an unusually long time. Then end the conversation. Success Criteria: Agent inspects currently active queries, checks lock contention, and identifies long-running transactions.
binary_rubric: Agent inspects active queries and investigates lock contention.
Agent identifies long-running open transactions to diagnose latency spikes.

scenarios.starting_prompt: Give me an inventory of the ${ALLOYDB_OMNI_DATABASE} database: which schemas exist, and what user tables live in each one.
scenarios.conversation_plan: The user wants a schema-then-table inventory. Accept a short summary and end the conversation. Success Criteria: Agent lists schemas and tables in the target database without executing arbitrary SQL.
binary_rubric: Agent provides a complete inventory of user schemas and tables.
